N01.title: Overfitting
N01.text: A model can fit training examples too closely and perform poorly on new cases.

N02.title: Gradient descent
N02.text: Gradient descent updates parameters opposite the gradient. A sufficiently small step can reduce a smooth loss locally.

N03.title: Features and labels
N03.text: Features are inputs to a model. Labels are the target values used in supervised training.
